preconditions.description: n is a non-negative integer representing the total number of courses.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(edge, list) and len(edge) == 2 and all(isinstance(course, int) and 0 <= course < n for course in edge) for edge in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: prerequisites is a list of edges where each edge is a pair of distinct courses within the valid range [0, n-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == (not any(course in [edge[0] for edge in prerequisites] for course in [edge[1] for edge in prerequisites]))
postconditions.description: The output is true if and only if there are no cycles in the directed graph formed by the prerequisites, meaning all courses can be taken without violating prerequisites.
